page.title: Setpoint
page.purpose: Show the setpoint as it actually is — every target with its sensor, deadband, actuator and honesty flag, and every open-loop cell with the date it was declared and how long it has stood.

regions.purpose: List every authored target with its sensor reference, deadband, actuator and honesty flag.
Separate the targets that have no working sensor, each with gap_opened_on and gap_open_days, so an intentionally visible hole can be told from an overdue one.

Report setpoint integrity findings — a target missing a sensor, deadband or actuator — and drift findings where a named sensor no longer resolves or an open cell could already be closed by a shipped verb.

states.description: Setpoint parsed. Targets, open-loop cells and integrity findings all shown.
The setpoint parses but one or more targets are malformed. The map still loads; the malformed rows are called out rather than dropped.
The setpoint document is missing, unreadable or unparseable. A hard, loud failure — no target count is shown.

priorities.statement: The setpoint is read-only here, and the page must look it.
priorities.notes: No edit affordance of any kind. Changing a deadband is an operator decision made through a reliability-target-update, not a UI action. An edit control here would be deviation D6 rendered in pixels.

priorities.statement: An open-loop target is presented as a declared state, not as missing data.
priorities.notes: Empty sensor cells are honest declarations. They are counted and dated, never hidden or shown as a failure.

claims.statement: The page exposes no control that would create, edit or delete a target, deadband or actuator.
claims.rationale: The instrument may not author its own setpoint. This is the most likely place for that boundary to be eroded by a well-meaning UI addition.

claims.statement: Every open-loop target displays the date its gap was declared and the number of days it has stood.
claims.rationale: Without the dates, 'declared and dated' degrades into 'declared once and forgotten' — the state three framework-health targets sat in indefinitely.

claims.statement: When the setpoint cannot be parsed, the page states the failure and its reason and shows no target count.
claims.rationale: An empty map rendered as zero targets would read as a scenario with nothing to measure rather than an instrument that lost its reference.
